book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Yɨɨsu arahorya rigata
Mmbe, hanʉ gayo gaasirirɨ, Yɨɨsu akaja Yɨrusarɨɨmu kurya isigukuru endebhe ya Abhayaahudi.

Yɨrusarɨɨmu muyo, chareho ikishoko kɨkʉrʉ kɨnʉ kikubhirikirwa Ikishoko cha Zɨngʼʉndu. Haguhɨ ni ikishoko kiyo, kwarɨ na ritabha rɨnʉ rikubhirikirwa mʉKɨɨbhuraaniya Bhɨtizaata. Ritabha riyo riinaarirwɨ na amabhuru ataanʉ ganʉ gaarɨ nɨ ɨkɨkʉngʉ.
Mʉmabhuru gayo, bhaarɨ bharahindɨramu abharwɨrɨ bhaaru, abhahʉku, abharema na bhanʉ bhakuurɨ ibhiimʉ. [Bhaarɨ bhararɨnda amanzi gabhuswɨ,
kʉ kʉbha maraika wa Mungu aarɨ araaza kubhusa amanzi mwitabha muyo. Umurwɨrɨ wʉnʉ aarɨ we embere kusikɨra mʉmanzi, wuyo aarɨ arahora ubhurwɨrɨ bhʉnʉ aarɨ nabhwɨ.]
Gatɨ waabhʉ, aarɨmu umusubhɨ wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ aarɨ umurwɨrɨ kwibhaga ryi imyaka merongo ɨtatʉ nɨ ɨnaanɨ.
Neho Yɨɨsu akamorora ahindiirɨ hayo, akamenya kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo arwarirɨ kwibhaga irɨɨhu. Akamubhuurya, “Oreenda kohora?”
Umurwɨrɨ wuyo akagarukirya Yɨɨsu, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nɨtaana ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉkʉntʉʉra mwitabha hanʉ amanzi gakubhuswa. Hanʉ nikwenda kusikɨra mʉmanzi, ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ ahaankangatɨra kusikɨra muyo.”
Neho Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Imɨɨrɨra! Gega ɨkɨragʉ chazʉ, ujɨ.”
Hayohayo, ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo akahora, akiitwɨka ɨkɨragʉ chazɨ, akatanga kogenda. Rʉnʉ ringʼana rɨnʉ ryakʉrirwɨ rwarɨ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ.
Kʉgayo, abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhakabhʉʉrɨra ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aahʉriibhwɨ, “Reero ni‑rusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ. Imigirʉ jɨtʉ gɨtakwisirirya kogega ɨkɨragʉ chazʉ.”
Nawe akabhuga, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aahʉriryɨ, newe aambuuriirɨ, ‘Gega ɨkɨragʉ chazʉ, ujɨ.’ ”
Abhakangati bhayo bhakamubhuurya, “Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ akubhuuriirɨ kokorabhu?”
Nawe ataamʉmɨnyirɨ wʉnʉ aamʉhʉriryɨ, kʉ kʉbha Yɨɨsu atarʉrɨkɨɨnɨ kwikɨ mwiribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaareho.
Hanʉ gayo gaasirirɨ, Yɨɨsu akabhona ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo mwihekaaru, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Itegeerera, nangʉ ʉhʉrirɨ. Ʉtagarʉkɨra kokora ʉbhʉbhɨ, ʉtaaza kʉnyaaka kʉkɨra chɨmbu waarɨ kʉnyaaka.”
Rogendo rʉmwɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo akaja kʉbhakangati bha Abhayaahudi, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, Yɨɨsu newe aamʉhʉriryɨ.
Neho abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhakatanga kʉnyaacha Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ arahorya abhaatʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ.
Nawe Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Bhaabha arahocha emeremo sikʉ zʉʉsi, na niinyɨ nɨrakora ɨbhuɨbhu.”

Mmbe, igʉrʉ wa amangʼana gayo, abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhakatanga komohya ɨnzɨra yu ukwita Yɨɨsu. Bhaarɨ bhareenda kokorabhu, kʉ kʉbha Yɨɨsu aarɨ arasarya imigirʉ jʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, nawe ɨkɨbhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu nɨ‑kʉ kʉbha aarɨ arabhuga, Mungu ni‑Wiisɨ. Kʉ kʉgambabhu, aarɨ ariikorya kʉbha angɨ Mungu.
Ʉbhʉnaja bhwu Umwana wa Mungu
Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra abhakangati bhayo, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, Umwana wa Mungu atakʉtʉra kokora ryʉryʉsi, nawe arakora ganʉ akorora Wiisɨ arakora. Ganʉ Wiisɨ akokora, nego Umwana akokora.
Wiisɨ asɨɨgirɨ Umwana waazɨ, na aramwerecha emeremo jʉsi gɨnʉ akokora. Na aramwerecha chɨmbu araakore amangʼana amakʉrʉ kʉkɨra ganʉ aarɨ akʉrirɨ, na niimwɨ mʉrarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu.
Chɨmbu Wiisɨ akuryʉra abhaku na kʉbhaha ʉbhʉhʉru, ɨbhuɨbhu Umwana wʉʉsi arabhaha ʉbhʉhʉru abhaatʉ bhanʉ akwenda kʉbhaha.
Wiisɨ atakʉtɨnɨra ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi, nawe amʉhɨɨrɨ Umwana waazɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉsi bhwʉ ʉkʉtɨnɨra abhaatʉ.
Kʉnzɨra yiyo, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharasʉʉka Umwana chɨmbu bhakʉsʉʉka Wiisɨ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ atakʉsʉʉka Umwana, wuyo atakʉsʉʉka Wiisɨ wʉnʉ aamutumirɨ.

“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwigwa amangʼana gaanɨ na kwisirirya Mungu wʉnʉ antumirɨ, wuyo anʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo atakutinirwa, nawe amarirɨ kwambʉka kurwa muruku na kusikɨra mʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano.

Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ribhaga rɨraaza, na ribhaga riyo rɨmarirɨ kuhika, abhaku bhariigwa riraka ryu Umwana wa Mungu. Neho abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉbha bharamwitegeerera, bharabha nʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano.
Chɨmbu Wiisɨ arɨ isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano, ɨbhuɨbhu amʉhɨɨrɨ Umwana waazɨ kʉbha isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhuyo.
Na amʉhɨɨrɨ Umwana waazɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉ ʉkʉtɨnɨra abhaatʉ, kʉ kʉbha ewe newe Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ.
Mʉtarʉgʉʉra amangʼana gayo! Rɨraaza ribhaga rɨnʉ abhaku bhʉʉsi bhakwigwa riraka ryu Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ,
bhʉʉsi bhararyʉka na kurwa muzimbihɨra. Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharakora amazʉmu, bharahaabhwa ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano, nawe bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharakora amabhɨ, bharatinirwa.

“Kɨtareeho kegero chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ nɨkʉtʉra kokora. Nɨratɨnɨra abhaatʉ chɨmbu Bhaabha akʉmbʉʉrɨra. Ɨtɨnɨrʉ yaanɨ ne‑ye eheene, kʉ kʉbha nɨtakokora chɨmbu inyimwene nikwenda, nawe nɨrakora chɨmbu akwenda Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
“Nɨraabhamenyeekererye amangʼana gaanɨ inyimwene, mʉtakʉtʉra kwisirirya ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhwanɨ kʉbha bhwa amaheene.
Nawe areho ʉwʉndɨ wʉnʉ akomenyeekererya amangʼana gaanɨ kwa niimwɨ, na niinyɨ nɨɨzɨ kʉbha, ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhwazɨ nɨ‑bhwa maheene.
Imwɨ mʉkatʉma abhahiri kwa Yoohana Ʉmʉbhatiizi, wʉʉsi akagamba amaheene igʉrʉ waanɨ.
Inyɨ nɨtakwisega ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhwa abhaatʉ, nawe nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi gayo, korereke mʉsabhurwɨ.
Yoohana Ʉmʉbhatiizi aarɨ nchɨ ɨkɨmʉrɨ kɨnʉ kikwaka na kʉmʉrɨka mukiirimya, na niimwɨ mʉkazomererwa ubhwɨrʉ bhuyo kwibhaga isuuhu.
Nawe inyɨ nɨnʉ ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra bhwa Yoohana bhurya, nejo emeremo gɨnʉ Bhaabha angʼɨɨrɨ kuhicha. Emeremo janɨ gereerecha kʉbha, Bhaabha newe antumirɨ.
Nawe Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ, umwene amɨnyɨɨkɨrɨɨryɨ kwa niimwɨ. Imwɨ mʉkɨɨrɨ kwigwa riraka ryazɨ, nʉʉrʉ korora chɨmbu arɨ.
Amangʼana gaazɨ, gatakwikara kwa niimwɨ, kʉ kʉbha mʉtakwisirirya wʉnʉ aatumirwɨ nawe.
“Mʉrakora umucha komohya Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, kʉ kʉbha mʉrakina mʉratʉra kobhonamu ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano. Mmbe nangʉ, Amaandɨkʉ gayo nego gakomenyeekererya inyɨ!
Nawe mʉraanga kuuza kwa niinyɨ, korereke mobhone ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano.
Inyɨ nɨtakwisega ubhukumya kurwa kʉbhaatʉ.
Nawe nɨɨzɨ chɨmbu imwɨ mʉrɨ, mʉtaana ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa Mungu mozekoro zaanyu.
Inyɨ niizirɨ kʉbhʉnaja bhwa Bhaabha, nawe mʉraanga kʉnsʉngʼaana. Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ araazɨ kʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ umwene, ewe mʉramʉsʉngʼaana.
Imwɨ mʉsɨɨgirɨ kukumibhwa na abhakɨndichanyu, nawe mʉtakomohya ubhukumya bhʉnʉ bhukurwa kwa Mungu umwene. Nangʉ, mʉratʉrabhwɨ kunyiisirirya inyɨ?
Mʉtakina kʉbha, inyɨ nɨrabhagamba kwa Bhaabha. Musa newe akʉbhagamba, kʉ kʉbha wuyo newe mukwisega.
Arɨɨbhɨ heene mwangiisiriiryɨ amangʼana ga Musa, mmbe, inyʉʉsi mwarɨ mʉranyiisirirya, kʉ kʉbha Musa akaandɨka amangʼana igʉrʉ waanɨ.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ mʉtakwisirirya amangʼana ganʉ gaandikirwɨ na Musa, mʉratʉrabhwɨ kwisirirya amangʼana gaanɨ?”
